notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l001: Yudakhin арына- = арна-, dedicate; not арын- (tire/grieve). The prior page ends with an object bound up, entrusted, and prayer; dedicating it to Semetey follows that context. Exact printed арынап retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l003: Source баладан is ablative with коркуп, afraid of the boy. Revised initial fear-for paraphrase to preserve direction; no invented explanation for fear.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l005: Болжол estimate/measure with жок before telescope rendered unmeasured range, contextual optical scope; no numerical range invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l022: Казыналык refers to upkeep at treasury expense, not a treasure-house breed of dog.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l034: Өлгөндө көргөн is hard-won child/death's-door lament formula; not a claim the child was literally born after his mother's death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l035: Аманат is something left in trust; draft deliberately leaves recipient unstated. Next verse says the son brings the hound to the speaker.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b003:l038: Көңүл бөлүн- literally heart/attention divided; broad emotional stirring in reunion context, no diagnosis or invented exclusive emotion. Repetition retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b005:l003: Bolpoң primary plump, endearing healthy fullness. Hawk, goshawk and falcon are maternal bird epithets for the returning son; repeated images retained rather than treated as new literal birds.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b005:l009: Сүйүнчү good tidings convention, often asks reward for news; here mother's joyful call, no payment invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b005:l012: Караан primary support/protection as well as visible form; maternal support epithet here, unlike following page's seeing a figure.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b005:l027: Primary Yudakhin казгалдак is a kind of wild duck; no unsupported species-level identification.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b005:l031: Primary Yudakhin кулаалы is forest buzzard/kite, while ак кулаалы specifically male harrier. Broad kite chosen; no vulture or modern species claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0801:b005:l033: Both mothers means Kanykei and Chiyirdi; maternal grandmother is called mother by the source, retained without genealogical correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b003:l001: Аманат trust/inheritance left by Manas; no claim Manas directly entrusted objects to the infant added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b003:l010: Дардай- primary immense/imposing physical presence; grandly refers to bearing and stature, no invented moral approval.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b003:l013: Башынан бери көрүнүп rendered coming fully into view; exact scope of башынан is less certain (from his head/from the outset). No invented body detail.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b003:l016: Каймана primary secretly/hidden, here protective leopard presence; extraordinary guardian animal retained as narrated, not rationalized.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b003:l021: Maternal self-offering formula retained, not an assertion they actually died or performed human sacrifice.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b004:l001: Зоңкулда primary howl/wail, exact зоңкулдап ыйла-; dog crying like a human retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b004:l018: Source shifts from your mother to my mother, retained; no silent pronoun harmonization.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b004:l030: Primary жошулуш- has exact affectionate reciprocal example with stars in sky; here source says rain, retained rain comparison and caressed one another. Not silently changed to stars or generic streaming tears.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0802:b004:l036: Белеӊдинин-Белинен provisional toponym Pass of Belendi; no modern geolocation claimed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b003:l012: Амалым is means/resource/hope; mother's fear of losing all hope with the puppy rendered contextually, not magical spell.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b003:l028: Leopard epithet in recalled threat refers contextually to Manas, kept as source epithet rather than expanding the name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b003:l036: Birch and willow weeping are explicit epic personification, retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b005:l008: Primary Yudakhin ай туяк under туяк: a horse designated for sacrifice; exact ай туякка чал- sacrifice. With six mares already specified, rendered slaughtered in sacrifice, no invented crescent-shaped procedure.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b005:l009: Primary Баабедин 1 Bahauddin patron of Bukhara, 2 sacrifice on deliverance; pledging an offering preserves both context and invoked name, no specific prayer invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b005:l014: Maternal/paternal morning-star epithet and source genitive reconstructed across following who-knows-worth line; no astronomical claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b005:l021: Назыр attested variant of назир, votive sacrifice/offering; not personal name or administrative vizier.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b005:l026: Causative slaughter has khoja and mullah as directed participants and bulls as objects; original ordering of all named participants and nine bulls preserved.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0803:b005:l035: Source shifts from God's creation and servant to Manas's son in two parallel rhetorical questions; each verse's content retained in order.
